title: You Must Take Away Sadness from People
body:
Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. Madad yaa Sayyidee, yaa Sultan al-Awliya, madad.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu
akbar, wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! Alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala Sayyidina Muhammad. Sayyidi ‘l-awwaleen wa’laakhireen, habeebul ‘alameen, yaa Rabb. (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)

As-salaamu `alaykum, ‘ibaadullah. As-salaamu `alaykum, servants! O our Lord (swt). Then, as-salaamu
`alayka yaa Sahib az-Zamaan, thumma as-salaamu `alayka yaa Qutub az-Zamaan, thumma as-salaamu
`alayka, Qutub al-Mutassarif fee kulli umoor. Happening on this world, who he is responsible for everything
and they are masumiya, masumi, just protected because they are doing everything on the name of the Lord of
Heavens. Therefore, they must be under special protection. They can’t do anything wrong, they are only
looking on the Preserved Tablet and they are going on it. They are protected ones, not to do wrong things.

As-salaamu `alaykum! Our listeners who are listening and asking to learn something, such a meeting is very

rare in this world, that they have a responsibility for the nation of Sayyidina Muhammad (s). (Mawlana
Shaykh stands and sits.) Allah Almighty is never leaving His most beloved one to be hazeen, sad; yes, He
never leaves. Therefore, everything that is happening here, when it is going to be presented through heavenly
stations, never going to be left in such a way that making Habeebullah to be sad, no. Allah Almighty is never
leaving His most beloved one to be sad. Here we may see some people who are sad ones, and if we can do
something to help those ones, we try to do. We are `ajiz, the weakest creatures; we can’t do anything and we
are going to be sorrowful also. If anything is making anyone to be sad, it is making us sad also.

And the Seal of Prophets (s), the most beloved one in the Divinely Presence, what do you think Salafi
`ulamas? What do you think about that point? Is Allah Almighty leaving His beloved one to be sad? If leaving
him to be sad, that means He can’t do anything. Allah Almighty is He who does everything as He likes, and
He Almighty is going to leave His most beloved one to be sad?

“For what are you sad, O My beloved one? O My beloved one, in the Night of Journey, O My beloved one, you
are always saying, ‘Ummati, Ummati.’ I am looking and seeing that you are worrying so much about your
nation. You know Me? Who am I? O My beloved one, do you think that I am not able to take away everything
from your nation that is making you to be sad? I am that One!!!”

(Mawlana Shaykh stands.) Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa
lillahi ‘l-hamd! (Mawlana Shaykh sits.) Oh, this is one ocean that you can’t find a beach or end or any deep,
this. “O My beloved one, I am not leaving you to be sad. Don’t worry, don’t worry.” Alhamdulillah yaa
Rabbee, shukr.

O People! Come and listen, come and try to understand. We must come and we must try to learn even
something for the value of the Seal of Prophets, Habeebullah (s). We must try to learn something from his
greatness, honor, love, and glory that has been granted to him. (Mawlana Shaykh stands.) La ilaaha illa-Llah.

La ilaaha illa-Llah. La ilaaha illa-Llah. Sayyidina Muhammad RasoolAllah . (Mawlana Shaykh sits.)

And we are saying, a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Shaytan is trying to make people to be sad,
very sad. And when we are feeling sadness, you must know that it is from Shaytan; he is asking to make you
sad. If you like not to be sad, what is the cure? The Lord of Heavens is saying, “O People! If you like not to be
sad, if you are finding someone sad, try to take that sadness from that one and I am taking away your
sadness.” Allah, Allah.

This is a teaching for whole nations! Now the whole world is in sadness, everywhere there is sadness. What
do you think about that sadness? How can we take away sadness from people? We are sending for Haiti,
countries and UN sending its wealth, because they are hungry and thirsty and no place to come under it and
to protect themselves. They are fearing another earthquake coming on them also.

O People! What are you doing to take away sadness? SubhaanAllah, Sultan Allah. SubhaanAllah, Sultan
Allah. We are saying bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. “Say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem, and I am
taking away your sadness.” We must say bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. Sadness never leaves a person
with gold or with high ranks to be president, kings, or sultan, no. Such ranks can never save people from
sadness. What is the way? Why are you not saying, Salafi `ulama? Why are you not saying what is the cure for
this? And you are looking and seeing that people are in trouble through miseries, through adhab and
troubles; people are like someone they were trolling through an ocean and their sailing boat just sank down,
destroyed. How are they going to be on that ocean, saving themselves? It is so simple.
Besides, now people, all of them, are now falling in trouble in Misery Oceans, Suffering Oceans, Difficulty
Oceans, and Cursing Oceans. They are in it from east to west, from north to south. Why are you not saying,
“Islam is bringing everything?” Li kulli dain dawaa, "for every illness there is a cure." Why for people giving
troubles and miseries and making them under high positions, what is the key to save them?! Is it not
mentioned through the Holy Qur’an?
